checks.evidence: Every source and output chunk, count, hash, attempt and reconstructed assertion reconciled.
The local and OKF Explorer relationship-assertion.v2 schemas had identical SHA-256; all 22,651 assertions validated.
Every target used canonical topic/<slug> form and joined a published topic.

55/55 positives, 55/55 near-miss negatives and 40/40 end-to-end cases passed with computed metrics. These authored lexical tests did not contain the European Social Fund or police-station collisions found in actual data.
Every assertion had an exact supported literal, valid evidence URL and deterministic derivation.
Assertions were model-assisted, derived, non-official and pending independent audit; verification was limited to deterministic evidence checks and made no independent/legal-assurance claim.
Actual-corpus sampling and scans found 147 European Social Fund collisions and 21 residual criminal-context Civil assertions.
74,846 previously unclassified records had usable titles but no new match; limitations explicitly state that no-match is not evidence of no topic.

findings.title: European Social Fund is systematically misclassified as UK social-security welfare
findings.what_failed: R041 matches the undifferentiated phrase 'social fund'. It maps 147 records about the European Social Fund to Social security and welfare, although those titles concern the EU structural/employment/cohesion fund rather than the UK discretionary Social Fund welfare scheme.

example.title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/697 ... on the European Social Fund ...

findings.why_it_matters: R041 actual-corpus semantic precision is at most 56.9% on this known collision, and nearly one quarter of the emitted Social security topic consists of the wrong named fund.
remediation: Exclude the exact named entity European Social Fund from R041.
Add a rule-level hard negative using an actual European Social Fund title.
If retained as discovery metadata, assign it to an appropriate EU/employment/cohesion concept rather than UK social-security welfare.

findings.title: Civil rules retain clear criminal-defence contexts without explicit criminal tokens
findings.what_failed: The explicit criminal, crime and prosecution exclusions work, but R009 still emits 17 police-station legal-advice records and R008 emits four prisoner-defence or defence-certificate records into Civil justice and procedure.

examples: The Legal Advice and Assistance at Police Stations (Remuneration) (Amendment) Regulations 2001
The Poor Prisoners’ Defence (Legal Aid Certificate) Regulations 1963

findings.why_it_matters: A lexical zero for 'criminal' does not establish Civil semantic precision; these titles name criminal-defence services through different vocabulary.
remediation: Add police-station, poor-prisoner defence and defence-certificate exclusions or route them to Criminal law and policing.
Use actual corpus examples as rule-level hard negatives.

findings.title: Prompt provenance remains a basis hash rather than the actual authoring prompt
findings.what_failed: The run's prompt_hash is derived from a synthetic prompt basis assembled by the deterministic generator. Exact model identity, actual task transcript hash and exposed parameters are not recorded in the run.
findings.why_it_matters: Rule execution is reproducible, but the model-assisted rule-authoring step is not fully reproducible from the run manifest.
remediation: Name the field prompt_basis_hash or link it explicitly to the evidence-governance transcript.
Record hashes and unavailable reasons for the exact transcript, model identity, parameters and schema.

findings.title: Run metrics still mix assertion and record grains
findings.what_failed: accepted_assertions is an assertion count, while rejected_records is a record count. records_with_accepted_assertions exists only in the provider manifest.
remediation: Add records_with_accepted_assertions to the run record.

findings.title: Nine calibrated rules emit no assertion in this snapshot
findings.what_failed: R002, R007, R014, R017, R024, R036, R042, R045 and R047 emit no assertion after matching and suppression; R007 has no raw corpus match.
findings.why_it_matters: This does not damage emitted data, but string-unit coverage should not be confused with actual-corpus rule coverage.
remediation: Publish zero raw, suppressed and emitted counts explicitly.
Treat unused rules as dormant or aliases until a corpus hit exists.

required_before_new_audit: Remove or reroute European Social Fund matches.
Remove or reroute police-station and prisoner-defence Civil matches.
Rebuild to a new digest and rerun full independent replay and actual-corpus sampling.
